kalyāṇi,.g: bhikkhunisaṁghe vuddhatarabhāvena thiraguṇayogena ca saṁghattheri sobhanehi sīlādīhi samannāgatattā sobhane kalyāṇi kalyāṇamitte ayye taṁ nissāya mayā tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṁ Buddhassa sāsananti yojanā.

Kalyāṇapaṭibhānavā.g: taṁtaṁitikattabbasādhanena upāyakosallasaṅkhātena ca sundarena paṭibhānena samannāgato.

Kalyāṇapaṭibhānava.g: taṁtaṁitikattabbasādhanena upāyakosallasaṅkhātena ca sundarena paṭibhānena samannāgato.

Kalyāṇimeva.g: idaṁ Satthā Jetavane viharanto omasavādasikkhāpadaṁ2 ārabbha kathesi.

kalyāṇimeva.g: catudosavinimuttaṁ kalyāṇiṁ sundaraṁ anavajjaṁ vācameva muñceyya vissajjeyya katheyya.

kalyāṇiyā.g: kalyāṇavācāya vissajjanameva imasmiṁ loke sādhu sundaraṁ bhaddakaṁ.

Kalyāṇarūpo.g: idaṁ Satthā Jetavane viharanto Cammasāṭakaṁ nāma paribbājakaṁ ārabbha kathesi.

kalyāṇī,.l: Sappaññasevī kalyāṇī, samattaṁ sāma taṁ vidū
kalyāṇī,.g: mahārāja taṁ mayā vuttaṁ ovādaṁ tvaṁ niccakālaṁ sappaññapuggalasevī kalyāṇaguṇasamannāgato hutvā samattaṁ paripuṇṇaṁ sāmaṁ vidū attapaccakkhatova jānitvā yathānusiṭṭhaṁ paṭipajjāti.

kalyāṇakammānaṁ,.g: yo esa mayhaṁ kalyāṇakammānaṁ devānañca ṭhānāni pāpakammānaṁ nerayikānañca pāpāni ṭhānāni dassesīti attho.

kalyāṇāni.l: Atthekaccāni kalyāṇāni kammasamādānāni gativipattipaṭibāḷhāni na vipaccantī
kalyāṇāni.g: evaṁ yojanā veditabbā–idhekaccassa bahūni kalyāṇakammāni honti, tāni gatisampattiyaṁ ṭhitassa vipacceyyuṁ.

kalyāṇamittaṁ.g: ettha pana duvidhaṁ kammaṭṭhānaṁ sabbatthakakammaṭṭhānaṁ pārihāriyakammaṭṭhānañca.

Kalyāṇamittānaṁ.g: yattha na sakkā hoti ācariyaṁ vā ācariyasamaṁ vā upajjhāyaṁ vā upajjhāyasamaṁ vā kalyāṇamittaṁ laddhuṁ.
